nodes.basis: maker name and listing; the maker table's rpm at low throttle is consistent with it (CALC-E1-CAL residuals)

nodes.title: Winding resistance 86 mOhm at 25 degC
nodes.text: phase-to-phase resistance of the X3108S KV900
nodes.basis: two retailer listings agree (Robu, HiModel); measure with a 4-wire milliohm method on arrival

nodes.title: No-load current 0.9 A
nodes.text: no-load current, used as speed-independent iron + friction loss
nodes.basis: listing value at 10 V (~9 000 rpm), two listings agree: conservative below that speed

nodes.title: ESC loss 10 mOhm + 0.5 W
nodes.text: ESC conduction path 10 mOhm (two FETs + leads) and 0.5 W fixed
nodes.basis: typical BLHeli_S 45 A FETs 3-4 mOhm each; the fit factor kP absorbs any error at the calibration points

nodes.title: Pack + harness 24 mOhm, avionics 1 A
nodes.text: 4S 6500 130C pack 20 mOhm (5 mOhm/cell, part-aged) plus 4 mOhm main lead and connector; avionics + servos 1 A from the bus
nodes.basis: E2 measures pack IR with the charger; F1 owns the harness resistance

nodes.title: Pack cells 20 mOhm, avionics 1 A
nodes.text: 4S 6500 130C pack, cells only: 4 x 5 mOhm (part-aged, 25 degC); avionics + servos 1 A from the bus. Harness from params electrical.r_ext_mohm
nodes.basis: E2's new-pack value is 4.0 mOhm/cell (ASM-E2-R-CELL); 5 mOhm/cell covers a season of cycling. E2 measures pack IR by load step (T-E2-IR)

nodes.title: Pack OCV states
nodes.text: open-circuit pack voltage: full 4.20, mid 3.80, low 3.60 V/cell (4S)
nodes.basis: 3.60 V/cell OCV is the 20 % reserve point of a LiPo; the sag case uses it

nodes.title: Copper 0.393 %/K, hot winding 80 degC
nodes.text: R_m(T) = R_25 (1 + 0.00393 (T - 25)); thrust-limit cases use an 80 degC winding, current-limit cases 25 degC
nodes.basis: annealed copper coefficient; 80 degC = hot after a hover

nodes.title: PER3-to-measured factors transfer between APC 11 in props
nodes.text: kT, kP fitted on the 11x4.7SF apply to the 11x4.5MR / 11x5.5MR PER3 data
nodes.basis: same maker, same code, same diameter; H1's thrust stand (T-E1-STAND) measures the fitted prop directly and supersedes this

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance 1.0 K/W in own wash
nodes.text: steady winding-to-ambient resistance of the X3108S in its own static prop wash
nodes.basis: maker's 94 degC at the 30 A row, 25 degC room, losses from this model (CALC-E1-CAL); the test was not steady, so the true value may be higher: E3 owns the thermal model

nodes.title: Pack-current limit 100 A
nodes.text: ArduPilot Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX = 100 A (with the power module's current sensor calibrated) caps the summed motor current
nodes.basis: 4 x 25 A = the X3108S's 25 A / 30 s rating; F4 sets it, F1 sizes wiring to it

nodes.title: Transition thrust margin 1.3
nodes.text: full thrust at every point of the level pitch-over corridor >= 1.3 x the thrust that holds level unaccelerated flight there
nodes.basis: 0.3 g of surplus for acceleration and gusts; same headroom as ASM-A2-GUST-THRUST-HEADROOM

nodes.title: Wing CL: linear to CLmax, flat plate after stall
nodes.text: CL = a alpha up to CLmax (a = 2 pi AR/(AR+2)); above stall CN = 1.98 sin(alpha) (flat plate); prop wash on the wing ignored
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat-plate normal force; ignoring wash lift is conservative for thrust required; B1/B2 refine

nodes.title: Worst pack state for hover T/W
nodes.text: the lowest pack state the aircraft is flown in: the 20 % reserve line (E2 ASM-E2-OCV-20), pack cold-soaked to 10 degC (E2 ASM-E2-COLD-R), windings hot (80 degC, after a hover), 100 A limiter set; pack resistance = cells x R_cell x cold + R_ext (E2's model)
nodes.basis: one definition shared with E2 (CR-E2/E1 reconciliation 2026-11-09); the battery failsafe lands the aircraft at the reserve line, so states below it are emergencies, reported as a sensitivity (3.60 V/cell OCV)

nodes.title: Prop stack dimensions
nodes.text: motor body (mount face to bell top) 26.5 mm; bolt-on adapter base 6.35 mm, M6x1 post 15.2 mm above the base; prop hub 0.35 in = 8.89 mm; M6 washer 1.0 mm; M6 hex nut ISO 4032 5.2 mm
nodes.basis: HiModel listing (body), Small Parts CNC adapter drawing values, APC 11x5.5MR page (hub), ISO 4032 / ISO 7089 (nut, washer); measure the supplied adapter on arrival

nodes.title: Motor screw length and engagement window
nodes.text: M3x8 SHCS (A2 stainless, same size as the old design's F01), no washer; thread engagement in the motor base 2.5-3.5 mm (>= 5 threads, tip clear of the stator). The plate and pad heights under the head are D3's (P:fin_detail.mount.*)
nodes.basis: X3108S base thread depth is not published: 3.5 mm is a conservative limit for a 31 mm stator base; probe the hole depth on arrival, the screw tip must stop >= 0.5 mm short of the bottom

nodes.title: Per-unit flying masses incl. leads, g
nodes.text: motor with factory leads 81.0 (no bullets: harness HRN-E03); ESC stripped of its factory power leads (F2 solders its own 16 AWG to the pads, D-48, CR-F2-07) with signal lead and heat-shrink 7.6 (6.6 g bare board + 1.0 g; was 11.0 with 2 x 80 mm 16 AWG); prop 17.0; bolt-on adapter 3.0 + 4 x M3x4 1.2 + M6 nut 1.9 + washer 0.6 = 6.7; 4 x M3x8 SHCS motor screws 3.2
nodes.basis: listings (81 g, 17 g, 3.0 g); ISO masses for screws, nuts, washers; the stripped ESC is EST from the 6.6 g bare board (D-48, CR-A3-21: -3.4 g per ESC); weigh everything on arrival

nodes.title: Fit PER3 to the maker's X3108S + 11x4.7 table
nodes.equation: kT = mean(T_meas / T_PER3(rpm)) ; kP: sum(P_bat,model(rpm) - P_meas) = 0 over rows 5-12 A ; R_th = (94 - 25) / P_loss(30 A row)

nodes.title: Hover operating point per motor, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR
nodes.equation: T_m = m_gate g k_dl / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm) = T_m ; I_bat, P_bat at V_bus = 14.8 V ; g/W = T_m / g / P_bat ; dT_wind = R_th P_loss

nodes.title: Full-throttle static thrust and current, all four motors
nodes.equation: duty = 1 ; V_bus = V_ocv - R_pack (4 I_bat + I_avn) ; T/W = 4 T_max / (m_gate g) ; cases: table basis (bus held 14.8 V, 25 degC), sag (OCV 14.4 V, R_pack, 80 degC), current limits (bus held 14.8 / 16.8 V, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Full throttle with the pack-current limiter Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX
nodes.equation: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim ; T/W = 4 T / (m_gate g) ; cases fresh (OCV 16.8 V, 25 degC) and low (OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC), with R_pack

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the worst pack state (E1 station model + E2 pack model)
nodes.equation: R_pack = cells R_cell k_cold + R_ext ; V_ocv = cells OCV ; largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim (station model, winding 80 degC) ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; f_sag = T_worst / T_fresh (fresh: 4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Prop stack, prop-to-structure gap, nut and motor-screw engagement
nodes.equation: s = L_body + t_base + h_hub / 2 ; x_tip = L_body + t_base + L_post ; e_nut = L_post - h_hub - t_washer - h_nut ; gap = face_ahead + s >= 0.14 D (B4) ; e_screw = L_screw - t_plate (D3 R3: plate canted with the motor, uniform under every head)

nodes.title: Propulsion flying mass, four stations, per-unit masses incl. leads
nodes.equation: m = n (motor + ESC + prop + adapter and nut + motor screws)

nodes.title: Cruise point on B1's polar: four props share the drag
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim (B1's polar, = CL-B1-CRUISE-DRAG) ; T_m = D / 4 ; solve rpm: T(rpm, J) = T_m ; eta_prop = T V / P_shaft ; eta_tot = T V / P_bat ; L/D_eff = W / D

nodes.title: Thrust margin along the level pitch-over corridor (sag case, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: min over V in [0, V_tr] of 4 T_full(V cos a, OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC) / T_req,min(V) ; T_req from T sin a + L = W, T cos a >= D ; polar CL-B1-CD0, CL-B1-K, ASM-B1-TRIM

nodes.title: One motor out: what is left (11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: hover: thrust/moment balance forces the diagonal partner to 0 -> 2 same-direction motors, T/W_2 = 2 T_max,worst / W, unbalanced yaw torque = 2 Q_hover ; cruise: 2 motors carry D, roll torque = 2 Q(T = D/2) for elevons to hold

nodes.title: Adapter screws M3x4 into the bell: strip model
nodes.text: d 3 mm; shortest engagement 2.0 mm; tightening torque 0.5 N m (C6); nut factor 0.2; shear allowable of the bell alloy 150 MPa; stripping area 0.5 pi d L (internal thread, conservative)
nodes.basis: VDI 2230 short form; 6061-T6 shear ultimate 207 MPa taken down to 150 MPa for an unknown bell alloy; measure the bell-top thread depth on arrival (T-E1-MOTOR-RM)

nodes.title: Adapter screw fit: head-seat flange 1.5 mm, M3x4 / M3x5, tip clear 0.5 mm, rule 1.0 d
nodes.text: the bolt-on adapter's counterbored flange leaves 1.5 mm of each screw above the bell top (M3x4 engages 2.5 mm, the declared E-PRP-01..04 value); candidate lengths 4 mm (vendor) and 5 mm; the screw tip must stop >= 0.5 mm short of the windings under the bell top; minimum engagement into metal 1.0 d (D-41, C6)
nodes.basis: Small Parts CNC adapter listing (M3x4 supplied) and the 2.5 mm declared engagement; D-41 joint rule; flange to be measured with the adapter (T-E1-MOTOR-RM)

nodes.title: ESC strap 1.5 mm thick, 10 mm band
nodes.text: one 10 mm hook-and-loop strap (fins BUILD, E3 ASM-E3-ESC-STRAP) over the ESC's FET face: single layer 1.5 mm where it crosses the ESC; the overlap sits on the inboard face of the pad, not on the ESC
nodes.basis: typical 10 mm hook-and-loop cable tie 1.3-1.6 mm; the ESC body (45 x 20 x 6 mm in heat-shrink, ASM-E3-ESC) bounds the 6.6 g 45 A BLHeli_S board, which generic listings give as 28.5 x 13 mm; LANRC publishes no drawing. Stripped ESC: F2's 16 AWG solder joints sit on the pads under the shrink, the signal lead leaves the aft end. Measure on arrival

nodes.title: Prop adapter screws: M3x4 under deviation D-58 or M3x5 at the 1.0 d rule
nodes.equation: e_L = L - t_flange ; e_rule = k d ; thread needed (D-58) = e_M3x4 ; free depth for M3x5 = e_M3x5 + tip clearance ; RF(e) = 0.5 pi d e tau / (T / (K d))

nodes.title: ESC installed envelope on the fin pad (for B4's drag and wash, E3)
nodes.equation: h = h_body + t_strap ; w = w_body + 2 t_strap ; A_front = w h (strap band, seen along x)

nodes.title: Modelled station: canted prop plane, keep-out, ESC on the pad
nodes.equation: x_face = x_tube - od/2 - bond_gap - collar_wall - face_ahead ; x_hub = x_face - s cos(cant) ; gap = (x_face + face_ahead) - x_hub ; dx_tip = D/2 sin(cant) + h_blade vs h_blade + clr ; esc: pad_len / L_esc ; slot inner edge (pad_h/2 - edge - slot_z) / (w_esc/2)

nodes.title: Prop adapter M3x4 in the bell: thread strip vs tightening preload
nodes.equation: F_pre = T / (K d) ; F_strip = 0.5 pi d L tau ; RF = F_strip / F_pre

nodes.title: Prop swept envelope about the hub mid-plane: 10 mm forward, 6 mm aft
nodes.text: axial extent of the rotating APC 11 in MR disc about its hub mid-plane, forward (thrust side, with coning) and aft: the real envelope behind ASM-E1-BLADE-HALF's symmetric 10 mm (CR-E1-16)
nodes.basis: CAD root section (14 mm chord at 48 deg) reaches 5.5 mm either side; the blades cone forward under thrust (EST 4 mm at hover), never aft (no reverse thrust on K09-L)

nodes.title: Canted prop disc to the CF motor tube: true clearance and the face_ahead it needs
nodes.equation: hub = face + s t(cant, sense) ; gap = min over the tube surface of dist(point, disc volume r <= D/2, -fwd <= axial <= +aft) ; face_ahead_needed: smallest face_ahead (0.5 mm steps) with gap >= clr

nodes.title: Canted prop disc (-6 / +10 mm envelope) to the CF motor tube, true surface gap
nodes.how: Built station: printed 25 mm gauge between the blade trailing face at the tip and the tube, blade turned through the wing-side position (T-E1-MOTOR-RM).
nodes.note: D-52 (cant sense -1) swings the wing-side blade tip aft over the tube: about 21 mm, against 38 mm with sense +1 (gap_sense_plus_m). Same finding as D3's CR-D3-26 (20.9 mm). The nearest tube point is at r 143.8 mm, 4 mm OUTBOARD of the 139.7 mm tip, 26.8 mm aft of the mid-plane: a tip-to-structure gap, so the mount chain is not exempted from KO-PROP and a hub-radius annulus would not remove it (rev 7). check.py 21.0 mm (hull), probe 21.2 mm (surface samples); every other flight part >= 25 mm (bore boss 25.4, tube plug 26.1, wing >= 33.5 mm)

nodes.title: Mount face_ahead that gives the 25 mm tube clearance (E1 envelope)
nodes.how: Recompute after any change to the stack, cant, cant sense or tube station.
nodes.note: for A1's CR-D3-26 decision: this is the least; E1 proposes 0.0075 m (CL-E1-TIP-GAP-AT-75, about +1 mm margin). Rev 7: with KO-PROP on E1's envelope and check.py's hull + distance test, check.py reports 0 keep-out errors at 0.0065 and 0.0075 and 4 (the tube, 24.5 mm) at 0.0060 (in-memory trials, team/E1/prop_clearance.json)

nodes.title: Prop disc to motor tube with face_ahead 0.0075 m (E1's proposal for CR-D3-26)
nodes.how: As CL-E1-TIP-GAP-TUBE on the R5 mount.
nodes.note: +5.0 mm of stack: prop plane x -0.0077 -> about -0.0127, hub 5 mm further from the collar (CL-E1-CAD-PROP-GAP rises); mount cheeks +5 mm (D3, C4 rocking stiffness)

nodes.title: Modelled prop hub centre x on the 7 deg canted axis
nodes.how: python -I redesign/subsystems/propulsion/make_propulsion.py prints the same x; calipers on the built station (T-E1-MOTOR-RM).
nodes.note: subsystems/propulsion/fusion/propulsion.py places the hub here; the datum DP-PROP is -0.0082 (D-28, D3's 39 mm stack). KO-PROP-<st> are registered on the modelled hub

nodes.title: Modelled hub minus datum DP-PROP
nodes.how: As CL-E1-CAD-HUB-X.
nodes.note: positive = the real prop sits aft of the datum, closer to the mount collar (CR-E1-29)

nodes.title: Prop plane to collar front along x, canted stack / 0.14 D
nodes.how: Calipers on the built station: collar front to hub centre >= 0.14 D = 39.1 mm.
nodes.note: same finding as CL-E1-PROP-GAP with the 7 deg cant included; passes since D3 carries face_ahead_m 0.0025 (D-51). A larger face_ahead (CR-D3-26, CL-E1-FACE-AHEAD-FOR-CLR) only raises it

nodes.title: Blade tip axial (x) excursion of the 7 deg canted disc, incl. the blade half
nodes.how: Recompute from the CAD bounding box of PRP-003-<st> after any cant or prop change.
nodes.note: information only since rev 5: KO-PROP-<st> is now the cylinder on the canted shaft axis (k9.prop_keepout rotate=rot, CR-A5-21), so this excursion is geometry inside the keep-out and the full 25 mm clearance is margin; check.py tests the tilted cylinder exactly. Since D-52 (sense -1) the wing-side tip swings aft, toward the motor tube: CL-E1-TIP-GAP-TUBE

nodes.title: Prop keep-out KO-PROP-<st> on E1's swept envelope (rev 7)
nodes.equation: aft face = aft + clr ; fwd face = fwd + clr ; half = (fwd + aft)/2 + clr ; centre shift ahead of the hub = (fwd - aft)/2 (k9.prop_keepout fwd=, aft=)

nodes.title: Prop keep-out axial half-length on the canted axis (swept envelope / 2 + clearance)
nodes.how: python -I redesign/fusion/check.py (hull + distance) and python -I redesign/team/E1/prop_clearance.py (surface samples).
nodes.note: rev 7: KO-PROP-<st> is registered with fwd 0.010 / aft 0.006 (ASM-E1-BLADE-ENV, A5's CR-E1-45 arguments), radius D/2 + 25 mm, centred 2 mm ahead of the hub; was 35 mm symmetric (ASM-E1-BLADE-HALF), which placed 4 mm of non-existent blade aft of the disc. check.py now reports the distance to the swept volume: only the CF motor tube is inside, at 21.0 mm (CL-E1-TIP-GAP-TUBE). The mount chain is NOT exempted: the tube's nearest point is 4 mm outboard of the tip, not behind the hub

nodes.title: Prop keep-out reach aft of the hub mid-plane (toward the mount, tube and wing)
nodes.how: Stand: photograph the tip against a scale at idle with 15 m/s blown across the disc (T-E1-STAND).
nodes.note: 6 mm swept envelope (blade section at the root; at the tip about 1 mm of section plus 5 mm for aft deflection when windmilling in a throttle-cut descent) + 25 mm

nodes.title: Prop keep-out reach ahead of the hub mid-plane (with coning)
nodes.how: As CL-E1-KO-AFT at full throttle (coning forward).

nodes.title: D3's pad length / ESC length
nodes.how: Lay the ESC in heat-shrink on a printed pad before the strap is threaded.

nodes.title: Strap-slot inner edge from the pad centre / ESC half-width
nodes.how: Thread the strap on a printed pad with the ESC in place: the strap must enter the slot beside the ESC.
nodes.note: the 20 mm ESC covers 1 mm of each 3 mm strap slot on the 28 mm pad; the strap then bends over the ESC edge inside the slot and cuts into the heat-shrink. D3: pad h 0.028 -> 0.031 m (CR-E1-30)

nodes.title: ESC envelope height proud of the pad at the strap band
nodes.how: T-E1-MOTOR-RM: calipers over the strapped ESC on a printed pad.
nodes.note: for B4 (CR-B4-20): use 7.5 mm, not the 6.8 mm of ASM-B4-ESC; the body is 6.0 mm proud outside the 10 mm strap band; length 45 mm along x, width 23 mm at the strap

nodes.title: ESC frontal area along x at the strap band
nodes.how: As CL-E1-ESC-PROUD.
nodes.note: 23 x 7.5 mm bounding rectangle seen along x; the ESC long side lies along x on the pad

nodes.title: M3x5 adapter-screw engagement minus the 1.0 d rule
nodes.how: T-E1-MOTOR-RM: depth gauge in a bell-top hole (thread length and free depth to the windings).
nodes.note: the compliant option of CR-A4-43: valid only if the bell top has >= 3.0 mm of thread and >= CL-E1-ADAPTER-M3X5-DEPTH of free depth; otherwise M3x4 under D-58

nodes.title: Free hole depth under the bell top needed for M3x5
nodes.how: T-E1-MOTOR-RM: depth gauge from the bell-top face to the first obstruction in each of the 4 holes.

nodes.title: Bell-top thread length that D-58 requires (M3x4 fully engaged)
nodes.how: T-E1-MOTOR-RM: thread length by a gauge screw turned in until it bottoms, minus the head seat.
nodes.note: D-58 grants the 2.0 mm minimum only if T-E1-MOTOR-RM measures at least this; below it the deviation lapses and the station is not flown (fallback: the motor-box adapter on its own screws, re-assessed)

nodes.title: Adapter screw thread strip RF at the declared 2.5 mm engagement
nodes.how: As CL-E1-ADAPTER-STRIP.

nodes.title: Adapter screw thread strip at 2.0 mm engagement vs preload (RF)
nodes.how: T-E1-MOTOR-RM: measure the bell-top thread depth; torque one adapter to 0.5 N m and off 5 times, threads undamaged.
nodes.note: cites the 2.0 mm minimum in E-PRP-01..04 (below the 1.0 d rule of D-41); service loads are 14 N shear and 4 N axial per screw, so the tightening preload governs

nodes.title: Thrust stand, one station, both candidate props
nodes.procedure: H1 stand (20 kg cell + HX711), X3108S + LANRC 45 A, 11x4.5MR then 11x5.5MR; held 14.8 V bench supply (>= 40 A) and then a flight pack; 10 % throttle steps to 100 %, 3 s each; log gf, A, V, rpm (optical tach or ESC telemetry), can temperature; one 60 s run at 689 gf for g/W; ten 10 -> 100 % throttle punches in < 50 ms with no desync

nodes.title: Incoming check: resistance, no-load current, mass, bolt pattern, hole and thread depth
nodes.procedure: Weigh motor, stripped ESC, prop, adapter set (0.1 g); calipers: base diameter (D3 needs >= 28 mm), base bolt pattern (D3 prints 16 x 19 mm), base hole depth (>= 4.0 mm, CL-E1-HOLE-DEPTH-MIN), bell-top thread length (>= 2.5 mm for D-58; >= 3.0 mm with >= 4.0 mm free depth -> M3x5, CR-A4-43), adapter flange under the screw head, motor phase-lead length from the base (F2's routed reach 0.121 m, CL-F2-PHASE-REACH: if the leads reach, no splice and F2 returns 12 g), ESC strapped on a printed pad (height proud), body length, adapter base and post; on the first built station a printed 25 mm gauge between the blade's aft face at the tip and the CF tube, blade turned through the wing-side position (R-PROP-CLEAR); 4-wire: 2.00 A from a bench supply through two phases, read the voltage drop (R = V / I); no-load current and rpm at 10.0 V without prop (Kv = rpm / (V - I0 R))

nodes.title: Tethered hover current
nodes.procedure: XPS aircraft at 2.6 kg, 30 s tethered hover; pack current from the power module; can temperature by IR at landing
